niche.habitat: deep lava-tube caves, the cave behind the waterfall, fog-filled gullies at dawn
niche.diet: cave moss and fungi, small grazers
niche.active: night and dawn fog; feeds at the meadow edge on moonless nights

body: small and light, dark back, glowing belly patches (ventral photophores), large ear-like click resonators, short legs for tube floors

links: it lives where light never arrives: lava tubes and fog-filled gullies
dense air carries sharp, far echoes

skill.effect: a ping outlines creatures through fog and cave walls

chains.weakness: a roar blinds it like a flashbang
observe: watch it cross a pitch-dark tube without hesitating
hear the clicks speed up near walls
roar near it and see it freeze

plausibility.summary: echolocation in dark caves is common on Earth; flocks should stagger clicks to avoid confusion

links: vocal calls would mask its own and the flock's echolocation
long echoes in lava tubes in dense air
glow chemistry comes from the cave fungi it eats

skill.effect: befriend by copying its light pattern; needs a glow part

chains.weakness: it stops talking when a sight hunter is near
observe: see a flock flash deep in a tube
notice the clicks pause while it flashes
see its belly, not its back, light up

plausibility.summary: a separate channel against acoustic masking is credible, but only as a dim, ventral, brief, refuge-bound signal
fixes: possibly a UV or polarised channel the predator sees poorly

chains.trait: only speaks on moonless nights and deep inside
links: moonlight drowns its signal and lights up its silhouette for sight hunters

skill.effect: befriending it is only possible on moonless nights or deep in the tubes

chains.weakness: on bright nights it hides deep and cannot be met
observe: visit on a bright night: silence
visit on a moonless night: flashing at the meadow edge
follow it deep on a bright night: it flashes there

journal.en: Silent in the cave. Why would something that loud keep quiet?
journal.es: Callada en la cueva. ¿Por qué algo tan ruidoso calla?

plausibility.summary: lunar and depth gating is adaptive: signal when contrast is high and risk is low
fixes: also gate on fog thickness and depth inside the tube

chains.trait: a predator fakes its light code
links: its code is a reliable signal of a meal
the predator sees its flashes at cave mouths

skill.effect: deep in the tubes the flock confirms identity by clicks, which a mimic outside cannot fake

chains.weakness: at the waterfall entrance a fake lure can draw it (and the player) out
observe: see a friendly flash at the cave mouth
follow it and meet the nocturnal creature
notice real flocks answer flashes with clicks

journal.en: Not every light is a friend.

plausibility.summary: a mimic-lure arms race is well documented; limit the lure to places with line of sight

analogues.mechanism: femme-fatale aggressive mimicry of Photinus codes

fixes: lure works only at gully mouths and the waterfall entrance

relations.note: the moonlit sit-and-wait hunter; learned to fake the light code
same dense, echoing air: Rondo talks by long hums, Ecolumbre keeps sound for seeing and talks with light

journal.en: Juveniles only click; the full light language comes with the breeding season.
journal.es: Las crías solo chasquean; el lenguaje de luz llega con la época de cría.

secrets: the waterfall-cave flock teaches Echo sight to a patient observer
moments: the first time a 'friendly' light at the cave mouth turns out to be a hunter

changelog.what: first example of the standard, from the owner's concept 'sees sound, talks with light'
